title: Comparison of finite-field and prime-field Artin–Schreier character sheaves
statement:
Let $k_0=\mathbf F_q$ with $q=p^r$, where $p$ is prime and $r\geq1$, let $\ell\ne p$ be prime, and put $L=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$. Fix a nontrivial additive character $\Psi:(\mathbf F_p,+)\to L^\times$. For every nontrivial additive character $\psi:(k_0,+)\to L^\times$ there is a unique $b\in k_0^\times$ such that $\psi(c)=\Psi(\operatorname{Tr}_{k_0/\mathbf F_p}(bc))$ for all $c\in k_0$.

For this $b$, let $X$ be any separated finite-type $k_0$-scheme and $f\in\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$. Let $\pi_q:Y_q=\operatorname{Spec}_X\mathcal O_X[y]/(y^q-y-f)\to X$, with translations $\sigma_c:y\mapsto y+c$ for $c\in k_0$, and let $\pi_{p,b}:Y_{p,b}=\operatorname{Spec}_X\mathcal O_X[t]/(t^p-t-bf)\to X$, with translations $\tau_d:t\mapsto t+d$ for $d\in\mathbf F_p$. In the category of lisse $L$-sheaves on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], there is an isomorphism
$$
\operatorname{im}\left(\frac1q\sum_{c\in k_0}\psi(-c)\sigma_c:\pi_{q*}L\to\pi_{q*}L\right)
\ \simeq\
\operatorname{im}\left(\frac1p\sum_{d\in\mathbf F_p}\Psi(-d)\tau_d:\pi_{p,b*}L\to\pi_{p,b*}L\right).
$$
Here constant sheaves are denoted by $L$, and translations act by pullback. Thus the degree-$q$ Artin–Schreier sheaf $\mathcal L_{\psi,f}$ of [def-fd-artin-schreier-sheaf] is the prime-degree $\Psi$-character sheaf for the function $bf$. The isomorphism commutes with pullback along morphisms of separated finite-type $k_0$-schemes (with $f$ pulled back).
